name: Corporate Pitch Template
description:
# Corporate Pitch Template

Ten-slide pitch deck template covering cover, problem, solution, market, product, business model, traction, team, ask, and closing. Uses a consistent navy + cyan palette with white sans-serif typography on a dark slide master. Each content slide demonstrates a different layout: split-image, three-bullet card row, KPI band, big-number callout, and quote-with-portrait.

## Suggested use
Clone the deck and replace the placeholder text with the agent's content; the layouts and palette stay constant.
applicability: Corporate pitch deck with consistent navy/cyan palette, 10-slide narrative arc, and varied layouts.

name: Data Storytelling Deck
description:
# Data Storytelling Deck

Eight-slide deck demonstrating chart-driven storytelling: cover, key metric, bar chart with annotation arrows, line chart with trend overlay, donut chart with category callouts, comparison table, insight summary, and closing CTA. All charts are native PowerPoint shapes (no images) so colours can be re-themed via palette swap.
applicability: Data-storytelling deck with annotated charts, comparison tables, and insight summary slides.

name: Minimal One-Pager
description:
# Minimal One-Pager

Single-slide layout in 16:9 with a 60/40 column split: large headline + 3-bullet body on the left, hero illustration on the right. Designed as a drop-in for product summary one-pagers and meeting handouts. Uses a single accent colour token for headline + bullet markers so the entire layout re-themes via one CSS-style variable.
applicability: Single-slide product summary one-pager with 60/40 column split and accent-color theming.
